title: SUBSIDY STEP 1: consumers persist as basal food descends 0.25 -> 0.05 on the paying-graze config?
headline: **PREDICTION SUPPORTED** — the pre-registered outcome occurred. This is one cohort of one engine version on one seed panel; it is not independent validation.
prediction: cons > 0 on at least 12/18 seeds at tick 6000 (machine criterion below) AND grazeEnergy > 0 sustained on at least 12/18 (human-read from B/D lines: the verifier has no graze metric). Coexistence NOT predicted.
falsification: FALSIFIED if cons = 0 on 7 or more of 18 seeds: the cut outran the link — hold the subsidy at 0.25, do not descend further, return to link/viability work. Separately, if consumers persist but grazeEnergy = 0 on >=7/18, the descent re-silenced the link and the config is incoherent: stop, do not interpret persistence as success.
